minimumMappingUnit.reason: The stored cell and patch products keep every connected component, including the very many single-cell components at 0.09 ha. A minimum mapping unit applied at this layer would silently change every count derived downstream, and the component counts in phase2-real-loss-component-inventory-1984-2022-v1 would no longer reconcile against the geometry. Speckle is a display problem, so it is solved at display time.
minimumMappingUnit.displayOnly: Tile generalization drops features below one rendered pixel at the zoom being written, which is a presentation parameter recorded per zoom in the tile manifest and never applied to the stored products.

unknownRule.statement: A patch polygon covers exactly the union of the observed-loss cells of its component. Rings are traced along cell edges, holes are preserved, and no fill, buffer, snapping or simplification is applied in the stored products.
unknownRule.consequence: The absence of a polygon means a cell was not observed as loss. It does not mean the cell was observed as non-loss, and it does not mean the cell was observed at all. Nodata cells lie outside every polygon and stay Unknown.
unknownRule.carriesInto: Any surface that draws this geometry must state that blank is not a claim of no loss.

simplification.reason: The run store is the authoritative geometry and is exact by construction. Simplification exists only in the tile pyramid, where it is a rendering decision, and generalized tiles may be drawn but never counted.

claims.reason: expert-review-100-per-province stands at zero of 100 in every province and published-independent-comparisons is unpublished. This geometry is unreviewed detection. Authorization to produce and publish it is not evidence about how often it is right.
